insurance_business_line.label: Insurance business line

risk_underwriting_distribution_model.label: Risk underwriting / distribution model

premium_exposure_mix.label: Premium / exposure mix
premium_exposure_mix.value: Specialty commercial exposures across Specialty Casualty, Property and Transportation, and Specialty Financial.

combined_ratio_p_c_underwriting.label: Combined ratio [P&C underwriting]
combined_ratio_p_c_underwriting.value: Calendar-year GAAP combined ratio with expenses measured against net earned premiums. AFG separately reports the current accident-year ratio excluding catastrophe losses.

loss_lae_ratio_p_c_underwriting.label: Loss / LAE ratio [P&C underwriting]
loss_lae_ratio_p_c_underwriting.value: Calendar-year net losses and loss adjustment expenses divided by net earned premiums.

regime_specific_solvency_measure.label: Regime-specific solvency measure
regime_specific_solvency_measure.value: U.S. statutory risk-based capital for domestic insurance subsidiaries, assessed against regulatory action levels.

notes: AFG’s investment and liability matching practices are unclear from the supplied evidence.
